title: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Action Masking and Projection for Battery Energy Storage Dispatch under Suppressed-Spread Market Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2609.23590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Battery energy storage system (BESS) dispatch must preserve operational feasibility while declining price spreads reduce the margin available to pay for cycling. We study a proximal policy optimization (PPO) controller whose pre-selection physical action mask and emergency projection are separated from a causal, forecast-informed economic advisory. All forecast-dependent methods receive the same causal 24-step forecast and grid-side settlement. Across five PPO seeds, advice-on net profit is 30.59 and 18.04 USD per 336-hour T1 and T2 window, versus 36.77 and 22.94 USD for proxy-cost MPC; PPO remains below this reference in both periods. Advice raises T2 profit from 16.45 to 18.04 USD while reducing throughput, but is immaterial in T1. On disjoint weekly blocks, PPO is stable under daily, weekly, and blended seasonal forecasts, weakens under persistence, and remains below proxy-cost MPC. translated_title: 面向价差受抑市场变化下电池储能调度的成本感知强化学习：动作掩码与投影方法
translated_abstract: 电池储能系统（BESS）的调度必须在保持运行可行性的同时应对价格价差收窄导致充放电循环收益空间被压缩的问题。我们研究了一种近端策略优化（PPO）控制器，其预选择物理动作掩码和紧急投影机制与因果的、基于预测的经济建议模块相分离。所有依赖预测的方法均接收相同的因果24步预测和电网侧结算数据。在五个PPO随机种子下，开启经济建议时的净利润在336小时的T1和T2窗口分别为30.59和18.04美元，而代理成本MPC分别为36.77和22.94美元；PPO在两个时期均低于该参考基准。经济建议将T2利润从16.45美元提升至18.04美元，同时降低了吞吐量，但在T1中影响甚微。在不相交的周区块测试中，PPO在日度、周度和混合季节性预测下保持稳定，在持续性预测下表现减弱，且始终低于代理成本MPC。配对诊断将性能变化定位于观测到的（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种将物理动作掩码与紧急投影机制同基于预测的经济建议相分离的成本感知PPO强化学习方法，用于价差收窄市场环境下的电池储能调度，但实验表明其净利润仍低于代理成本MPC基准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cost-aware PPO reinforcement learning approach for battery energy storage dispatch under suppressed price spreads, separating physical action masking and emergency projection from forecast-informed economic advice, though it still underperforms the proxy-cost MPC baseline.
